name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A foundational pressing movement for building overall chest strength and size. Keep your shoulder blades retracted to protect the shoulders.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack with straight wrists.
Lower the bar to mid-chest while keeping elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press the bar upward until elbows are extended without over-arching.

name: Incline Bench Press
description: Targets the upper chest and front delts with a steeper pressing angle. Use controlled reps to keep tension on the pecs.

form_guide.instruction: Set the bench to a moderate incline and lie back with feet planted.
Unrack the bar over the upper chest with a stable shoulder position.
Lower to the upper chest in a controlled path.
Press up and back to the start while keeping your torso tight.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Allows greater range of motion and independent arm control for chest development. Keep the dumbbells balanced through the full press.

form_guide.instruction: Sit on a flat bench with dumbbells on your thighs.
Lie back and position dumbbells at chest level with neutral wrists.
Press both dumbbells up until arms are extended.
Lower slowly until elbows are slightly below bench level.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: A stable pressing variation that helps isolate the chest with less balance demand. Great for controlled hypertrophy work.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust seat so handles align with mid-chest.
Grip handles and brace your core against the pad.
Press handles forward until arms are nearly straight.
Return under control without letting the weight stack slam.

name: Cable Fly
description: Emphasizes chest contraction through an arcing motion and constant cable tension. Keep a soft bend in the elbows throughout.

form_guide.instruction: Set cables just above shoulder height and step into a split stance.
Start with arms open and chest lifted.
Bring handles together in front of your chest in a hugging arc.
Pause briefly, then return to the stretched position with control.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description: A machine fly that isolates the chest with a fixed movement path. Focus on squeezing your pecs rather than moving heavy weight.

form_guide.instruction: Set seat height so elbows align with shoulder level.
Place forearms on pads with chest up and back supported.
Bring arms together until pads nearly touch.
Open back to the start slowly to maintain tension.

name: Push Up
description: A classic bodyweight press that builds chest, triceps, and core stability. Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.

form_guide.instruction: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder width on the floor.
Brace your core and set a straight plank position.
Lower chest toward the floor while keeping elbows angled back.
Press back up to full plank without letting hips sag.

name: Chest Dip
description: A dip variation biased toward chest by leaning the torso forward. Use a controlled descent to avoid shoulder irritation.

form_guide.instruction: Grip dip bars and support yourself with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward and cross your ankles.
Lower until upper arms are near parallel to the floor.
Press up while keeping the forward torso angle.

name: Deadlift
description: A full posterior-chain lift that strongly develops back strength and total-body power. Prioritize a neutral spine and tight setup.

form_guide.instruction: Stand with mid-foot under the bar and feet hip-width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bar, and set a flat back with lats engaged.
Push through the floor and lift the bar close to your shins.
Stand tall at lockout, then lower by hinging and bending knees.

name: Pull Up
description: A bodyweight vertical pull that builds lats and upper-back strength. Use full range and avoid swinging for best results.

form_guide.instruction: Hang from a bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders.
Depress shoulders and brace your core before pulling.
Pull chest toward the bar by driving elbows down.
Lower to a dead hang with control.

name: Lat Pulldown Wide
description: A scalable vertical pulling movement targeting the lats and upper back. Keep torso stable and pull with your elbows.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust knee pad and grip bar wider than shoulder width.
Sit tall with slight lean back and chest lifted.
Pull bar to upper chest while driving elbows downward.
Return bar overhead slowly until arms are extended.

name: Barbell Row
description: A horizontal pull that builds thickness in the mid and upper back. Maintain a strong hinge and minimize torso momentum.

form_guide.instruction: Hinge at hips with knees slightly bent and torso near parallel.
Hold bar with overhand grip just outside knees.
Row bar toward lower ribs by squeezing shoulder blades together.
Lower bar under control while keeping back neutral.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: A controlled row variation for mid-back and lats using constant cable tension. Avoid leaning excessively to keep the back doing the work.

form_guide.instruction: Sit with feet braced and hold the row handle.
Start with neutral spine and shoulders down.
Pull handle toward your lower ribs while driving elbows back.
Extend arms forward slowly without rounding your back.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Targets the mid-back with a stable row path and heavy loading potential. Keep your chest supported or torso fixed for strict reps.

form_guide.instruction: Position yourself on the machine and grip the handles firmly.
Set your torso angle and brace your core.
Row the weight toward your chest by pulling elbows back.
Lower until arms are fully extended with control.

name: Machine Row
description: A guided rowing movement useful for isolating upper and mid-back muscles. Focus on scapular retraction at peak contraction.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust chest pad and seat so handles are within reach.
Grip handles and keep chest against the pad.
Pull handles toward your torso while squeezing your back.
Return to start in a controlled manner.

name: Face Pull
description: Strengthens rear delts and upper back while supporting shoulder health. Keep elbows high and externally rotate at the end range.

form_guide.instruction: Set rope at upper chest or face height on a cable machine.
Step back to create tension and hold rope with thumbs toward you.
Pull rope toward your face, separating hands as elbows flare out.
Pause, then return slowly while maintaining posture.

name: Overhead Barbell Press
description: A primary compound movement for shoulder and triceps strength. Keep ribs down and press in a vertical bar path.

form_guide.instruction: Stand with bar at upper chest and hands just outside shoulders.
Brace core and glutes to stabilize your torso.
Press bar overhead while moving your head slightly back then through.
Lower bar to upper chest under control.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: Develops the shoulders with independent arm motion and improved stability demand. Use full control to avoid lower-back compensation.

form_guide.instruction: Sit upright on a bench with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Keep wrists stacked over elbows and core braced.
Press dumbbells overhead until arms are extended.
Lower back to shoulder level slowly.

name: Arnold Press
description: A rotational shoulder press that increases anterior and medial delt involvement. Perform smoothly to keep constant tension.

form_guide.instruction: Sit with dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you.
Start pressing while rotating palms outward.
Finish overhead with palms facing forward.
Reverse the motion back to the starting position.

name: Lateral Raise
description: Isolates the side delts to build shoulder width and shape. Keep the lift strict and avoid swinging.

form_guide.instruction: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with slight elbow bend.
Raise arms out to shoulder height in a wide arc.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower dumbbells slowly to the starting position.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Provides continuous tension on the side delts through the full range. Great for controlled hypertrophy work with lighter loads.

form_guide.instruction: Set a single cable to the lowest position and stand side-on.
Hold handle with outside hand and keep torso braced.
Raise arm laterally to shoulder height.
Lower with control and avoid pulling with momentum.

name: Rear Delt Fly
description: Targets the rear delts and upper back for balanced shoulder development. Keep motion wide and controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Hinge at hips with dumbbells hanging below shoulders.
Maintain a neutral spine and slight bend in elbows.
Lift arms out and back until aligned with shoulders.
Lower slowly to the start without rounding forward.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
description: A machine-based rear delt movement that limits cheating. Focus on driving through elbows and squeezing upper back.

form_guide.instruction: Sit facing the machine pad and grip handles at shoulder height.
Keep chest tall and shoulders down.
Pull arms outward and back until shoulder blades contract.
Return slowly while maintaining posture.

name: Shrug
description: Builds upper traps and neck support strength through scapular elevation. Use controlled range and avoid rolling the shoulders.

form_guide.instruction: Stand with dumbbells at your sides and arms straight.
Elevate shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause briefly at peak contraction.
Lower shoulders back to neutral under control.

name: Barbell Curl
description: A staple arm exercise for building overall biceps mass. Keep elbows fixed by your sides throughout the rep.

form_guide.instruction: Stand upright with underhand grip slightly wider than hips.
Brace core and keep elbows close to your torso.
Curl bar to shoulder height without swinging.
Lower bar slowly until elbows are fully extended.

name: EZ Bar Curl
description: A curl variation with wrist-friendly grip angles that still heavily targets the biceps. Control both lift and lowering phases.

form_guide.instruction: Hold EZ bar on angled grips with underhand position.
Stand tall and set elbows close to your sides.
Curl bar up toward upper chest.
Lower to full extension without shoulder sway.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Allows unilateral control and supination for strong biceps contraction. Keep upper arm position stable to reduce cheating.

form_guide.instruction: Stand with dumbbells at sides and palms facing in.
Curl up while rotating palms to face upward.
Squeeze biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and rotate back to neutral.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Targets brachialis and brachioradialis for fuller arm development. Neutral grip helps reduce wrist strain.

form_guide.instruction: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep elbows close and torso still.
Curl weights up while maintaining neutral grip.
Lower under control to full arm extension.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Stretches the biceps at the bottom for strong hypertrophy stimulus. Keep shoulders pinned back on the bench.

form_guide.instruction: Sit on an incline bench with arms hanging straight down.
Start with palms forward and elbows behind torso line.
Curl dumbbells upward without moving shoulders.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Preacher Curl
description: An isolation curl that limits momentum and emphasizes biceps peak tension. Move deliberately to protect the elbows.

form_guide.instruction: Set upper arms firmly on preacher pad.
Grip bar with underhand shoulder-width hold.
Curl bar upward until forearms are nearly vertical.
Lower slowly to near full extension.

name: Cable Curl
description: Maintains continuous tension on the biceps through the full motion. Keep elbows fixed to maximize isolation.

form_guide.instruction: Attach straight bar to low cable and stand upright.
Grip bar underhand with elbows tucked close.
Curl bar toward chest while keeping shoulders still.
Lower slowly until arms are fully extended.

name: Concentration Curl
description: A strict single-arm curl that enhances mind-muscle connection in the biceps. Great for finishing sets with high control.

form_guide.instruction: Sit on a bench and brace elbow against inner thigh.
Start with arm extended and palm facing forward.
Curl dumbbell up toward shoulder without moving upper arm.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Rope Pushdown
description: A triceps isolation movement that emphasizes full elbow extension. Spread the rope at the bottom for stronger contraction.

form_guide.instruction: Attach rope to high pulley and stand with slight forward lean.
Keep elbows pinned near your sides.
Push rope down until arms are straight and hands separate.
Return to start slowly while keeping elbows fixed.

name: Overhead Cable Extension
description: Targets the long head of the triceps in a stretched overhead position. Keep upper arms stable and avoid flaring too much.

form_guide.instruction: Face away from a low cable with rope overhead.
Step forward into split stance and lock upper arms in place.
Extend elbows to press rope forward and upward.
Bend elbows slowly back to stretched position.

name: Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension that strongly loads the elbow extensors. Use controlled tempo to protect elbows.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on a bench holding EZ bar above chest with arms straight.
Keep upper arms mostly vertical.
Lower bar toward forehead by bending elbows.
Extend elbows to return bar to start.

name: Close Grip Bench Press
description: A compound press that shifts emphasis to triceps using a narrower grip. Keep wrists stacked and elbows controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Set up on flat bench with hands just inside shoulder width.
Unrack bar and hold above lower chest.
Lower bar with elbows tucked closer to torso.
Press up to lockout while maintaining shoulder stability.

name: Bench Dip
description: A bodyweight triceps movement using a bench for support. Keep shoulders down and range controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Place hands on bench edge with fingers forward and legs extended.
Slide hips off bench and keep chest lifted.
Lower body by bending elbows to roughly 90 degrees.
Press back up by extending elbows.

name: Parallel Bar Dip
description: A compound upper-body movement with strong triceps involvement when kept upright. Control depth to match shoulder comfort.

form_guide.instruction: Support body on parallel bars with arms locked.
Keep torso mostly upright and core engaged.
Lower until elbows bend around 90 degrees.
Press back up to full elbow extension.

name: Tricep Kickback
description: An isolation move that trains triceps lockout and control. Keep upper arm fixed parallel to the torso.

form_guide.instruction: Hinge forward with one hand on bench and dumbbell in opposite hand.
Raise upper arm to torso level with elbow bent.
Extend elbow fully by kicking dumbbell backward.
Return to bent-elbow position slowly.

name: Wrist Curl
description: Isolates forearm flexors to improve grip endurance and arm development. Use a slow tempo through full wrist range.

form_guide.instruction: Sit with forearms on thighs or bench, palms up, wrists off edge.
Hold barbell with relaxed but secure grip.
Curl wrists upward as high as possible.
Lower wrists slowly to a stretch.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Strengthens forearm extensors for balanced wrist development. Keep movement small and controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Rest forearms on thighs or bench with palms facing down.
Grip bar just outside shoulder width.
Extend wrists to lift knuckles upward.
Lower back down under control.

name: Reverse Curl
description: A pronated curl variation emphasizing brachioradialis and forearms. Keep elbows tucked and avoid torso swing.

form_guide.instruction: Hold EZ bar with overhand grip at shoulder width.
Stand tall with elbows close to sides.
Curl bar upward while maintaining overhand grip.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Farmer's Carry
description: A loaded carry that builds grip strength, trunk stability, and work capacity. Walk with posture tall and controlled steps.

form_guide.instruction: Pick up heavy dumbbells with a neutral spine.
Stand tall with shoulders down and core braced.
Walk forward in short, steady steps.
Set weights down safely by hinging at the hips.

name: Back Squat
description: A fundamental lower-body lift for quads, glutes, and overall strength. Maintain a stable brace and consistent depth.

form_guide.instruction: Position bar on upper back and step out with feet shoulder-width.
Brace core and keep chest up.
Sit down and back until hips reach desired depth.
Drive through mid-foot to stand back up.

name: Front Squat
description: A quad-focused squat variation requiring strong torso uprightness. Keep elbows high to maintain rack position.

form_guide.instruction: Rack bar across front delts with elbows lifted high.
Stand with feet about shoulder-width and core tight.
Descend straight down while keeping torso upright.
Push through floor to return to standing.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine compound for quads and glutes with high loading potential. Control depth and avoid locking knees hard.

form_guide.instruction: Sit in machine with feet shoulder-width on platform.
Release safety handles while keeping knees soft.
Lower platform until knees bend deeply without pelvis lifting.
Press platform away to near full extension.

name: Hack Squat
description: A guided squat pattern that emphasizes quads and allows stable heavy training. Keep your back fully against the pad.

form_guide.instruction: Set shoulders under pads and feet on platform.
Unlock machine and brace your torso.
Lower until thighs approach parallel or comfortable depth.
Drive through feet to return to the start.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A unilateral leg exercise that develops quads, glutes, and balance. Keep front foot planted and torso controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Place rear foot on bench behind you and front foot forward.
Hold dumbbells at sides and brace your core.
Lower straight down by bending front knee and rear knee.
Push through front heel to return to standing.

name: Walking Lunge
description: A dynamic lower-body movement that builds leg strength and coordination. Take controlled steps and keep trunk upright.

form_guide.instruction: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Step forward and lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Drive through front foot and bring rear leg through.
Repeat with alternating steps while maintaining balance.

name: Leg Extension
description: An isolation exercise for quads useful for focused hypertrophy and pre-fatigue. Control the top and bottom positions.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust seat and pad so knees align with machine pivot.
Grip handles and keep hips pinned to the seat.
Extend knees to lift pad until legs are nearly straight.
Lower slowly to starting bend.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip-hinge movement emphasizing hamstrings and glutes. Maintain a neutral spine and slight knee bend.

form_guide.instruction: Stand holding barbell at thighs with feet hip-width apart.
Push hips back while keeping bar close to legs.
Lower until hamstrings are stretched and back stays flat.
Drive hips forward to stand tall again.

name: Leg Curl
description: Isolates hamstrings for knee-flexion strength and muscle growth. Use strict reps and avoid hip lifting.

form_guide.instruction: Set machine so knee joint aligns with pivot point.
Position pads against lower legs and brace torso.
Curl heels toward glutes as far as comfortable.
Lower weight slowly back to full extension.

name: Hip Thrust
description: A glute-dominant lift that builds powerful hip extension. Keep chin tucked and avoid overextending the lower back.

form_guide.instruction: Sit with upper back against bench and bar over hips.
Plant feet shoulder-width and brace your core.
Drive through heels to lift hips until torso is parallel to floor.
Pause at top, then lower hips with control.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: Targets the gastrocnemius with body upright and knees extended. Use full range from deep stretch to high contraction.

form_guide.instruction: Position shoulders under pads with balls of feet on platform edge.
Lower heels to feel a calf stretch.
Press through toes to raise heels as high as possible.
Lower slowly back into stretch.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Emphasizes the soleus by training calves with bent knees. Keep movement smooth and pause at both ends.

form_guide.instruction: Sit with knees under pads and feet on platform.
Release safety and lower heels for a stretch.
Push through forefoot to lift heels upward.
Return to bottom under control.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
description: A calf-focused movement on the leg press platform with stable support. Keep knees nearly fixed and move through ankles only.

form_guide.instruction: Place forefoot on lower edge of leg press platform.
Extend legs with a slight knee bend and brace torso.
Lower heels to stretch calves.
Press through toes to raise heels back up.

name: Single Leg Calf Raise
description: Builds unilateral calf strength and improves ankle stability. Keep balance support light and movement controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Stand on one foot on a step with heel hanging off edge.
Hold support lightly for balance.
Lower heel below step for stretch, then rise onto toes.
Repeat controlled reps before switching sides.

name: Crunch
description: A simple trunk-flexion move for upper abdominal activation. Keep the motion short and focused on rib-to-pelvis curl.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place hands lightly by ears or crossed on chest.
Curl shoulders off the floor by contracting abs.
Lower slowly without fully relaxing your core.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Adds resistance to abdominal flexion for progressive overload. Focus on spinal flexion rather than hip movement.

form_guide.instruction: Kneel facing a high cable while holding rope by your head.
Set hips still and brace before each rep.
Crunch torso downward by bringing ribs toward pelvis.
Return slowly to the start without losing tension.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
description: A challenging core movement that trains lower abs and hip flexors. Avoid swinging by controlling the start and finish.

form_guide.instruction: Hang from a bar with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Brace core and keep legs together.
Raise legs until thighs are near parallel or higher.
Lower legs slowly to the dead-hang position.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: Targets lower abdominal fibers by lifting the pelvis rather than upper torso. Keep movement controlled and compact.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on back with knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press lower back gently into the floor.
Curl pelvis upward to bring knees toward chest.
Lower hips down slowly without swinging legs.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: An anti-extension core exercise that challenges deep abdominal control. Move only as far as you can keep the spine neutral.

form_guide.instruction: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel beneath shoulders.
Brace core and squeeze glutes before rolling out.
Roll forward slowly while maintaining a neutral spine.
Pull wheel back to start using abs and lats.

name: Sit Up
description: A full-range trunk flexion exercise for abdominal endurance. Avoid jerking with the neck and keep movement controlled.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on back with knees bent and feet anchored if needed.
Cross arms on chest or place hands lightly at temples.
Curl torso up until sitting upright.
Lower back down slowly to the floor.

name: Plank
description: An isometric core exercise for trunk stiffness and posture control. Keep hips level and breathe steadily.

form_guide.instruction: Set forearms on floor with elbows under shoulders.
Extend legs behind you into a straight body line.
Brace abs and glutes while holding position.
Maintain neutral spine and controlled breathing for target time.

name: Side Plank
description: Strengthens obliques and lateral core stability in an anti-side-bend position. Keep shoulders and hips stacked.

form_guide.instruction: Lie on one side with elbow directly under shoulder.
Stack feet and lift hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from head to heels.
Breathe steadily, then repeat on the other side.

name: Lat Pulldown Narrow
description: A close-grip lat pulldown that increases stretch and range of motion through the lats. Keep elbows tucked and pull through the back.

form_guide.instruction: Grip the bar with a shoulder-width or narrower grip and sit with knees secured.
Sit tall with a slight lean back and chest lifted.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving elbows straight down.
Return bar overhead slowly until arms are fully extended.

name: One Arm DB Row
description: A unilateral dumbbell row that builds thickness in the mid-back and lats. Brace on a bench for stability and focus on pulling with the elbow.

form_guide.instruction: Place one knee and same-side hand on a bench for support.
Hold the dumbbell with the free hand, arm extended toward the floor.
Row the dumbbell up toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Lower the dumbbell under control to full extension.

name: One Arm DB Machine
description: A machine-assisted unilateral row for isolating each side of the back with added stability. Focus on squeezing the lat at the top.

form_guide.instruction: Set the machine handle to chest height and sit or stand in position.
Grip the handle with one hand and keep your chest tall.
Pull the handle toward your hip, driving your elbow back.
Return to the start position slowly with full arm extension.

name: Incline DB Press
description: A dumbbell press on an incline bench that emphasizes the upper chest and front delts. Greater range of motion than a barbell variation.

form_guide.instruction: Set the bench to a 30–45 degree incline and sit with dumbbells on your thighs.
Lie back and press the dumbbells to chest height with palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells up until arms are extended above your upper chest.
Lower slowly until elbows are slightly below bench level.

name: Decline DB Press
description: Targets the lower chest fibers using dumbbells on a decline angle. Keep shoulder blades retracted throughout.

form_guide.instruction: Set the bench to a decline and secure your feet at the top.
Hold dumbbells at chest height with palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells up until arms are extended.
Lower slowly until elbows are just below bench level.

name: Incline Pec Dec Fly
description: A machine fly variation on an incline angle that emphasizes the upper chest fibers with constant tension.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust the pec deck seat so handles are at upper chest level.
Grip the handles and keep a slight bend in your elbows throughout.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest in a hugging arc.
Return arms out slowly to feel a full stretch in the upper chest.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: A stable overhead pressing movement using a machine to target the front and side deltoids. Great for controlled hypertrophy.

form_guide.instruction: Adjust the seat so handles are at shoulder height.
Grip handles and keep your back flat against the pad.
Press handles overhead until arms are nearly extended.
Lower handles back to shoulder height under control.

name: Cable Bar Pushdown
description: A cable tricep exercise using a straight or EZ bar attachment that emphasizes the lateral head of the triceps.

form_guide.instruction: Attach a bar to the high cable pulley and grip it with palms facing down, slightly narrower than shoulder width.
Keep elbows pinned to your sides throughout the movement.
Push the bar down until arms are fully extended.
Return the bar slowly until forearms are parallel to the floor.

name: Cable Reverse Curl
description: Builds the brachialis and forearm muscles using an overhand grip on a cable for constant tension.

form_guide.instruction: Attach a straight bar to the low cable and grip with palms facing down.
Stand tall with elbows pinned to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Lower the bar slowly back to the starting position.

name: Squats
description: The fundamental bodyweight squat that builds lower body strength, mobility, and stability. Focus on depth and keeping your chest up.

form_guide.instruction: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall throughout.
Lower by pushing knees out and sitting back until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up to full extension.

name: Hip Abduction
description: Isolates the outer glutes and hip abductor muscles using a machine. Keep movements controlled and avoid momentum.

form_guide.instruction: Sit on the abductor machine and adjust pads to rest on your outer thighs.
Sit upright with your back against the pad and feet planted.
Push your legs outward against the pads as far as comfortable.
Return legs together slowly with control.

name: Hip Adductor
description: Isolates the inner thigh adductor muscles using a machine. Focus on a slow, controlled squeeze.

form_guide.instruction: Sit on the adductor machine and adjust pads to rest on your inner thighs.
Sit upright with your back against the pad and feet planted.
Squeeze your legs inward against the pads until they meet.
Return legs outward slowly to feel a full stretch.

name: Front Raise
description: Isolates the front delts by lifting the arms directly in front of the body. Keep the movement strict and avoid swinging.

form_guide.instruction: Stand tall holding dumbbells in front of your thighs with palms facing down.
Raise both arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower dumbbells slowly back to the starting position.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Press
description: A compound shoulder movement using dumbbells for independent arm control and greater range of motion. Keep core braced throughout.

form_guide.instruction: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Brace your core and keep your back upright.
Press dumbbells overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Extension
description: Isolates the long head of the triceps by extending overhead. Keep your elbows locked in and avoid flaring.

form_guide.instruction: Hold one dumbbell with both hands and lift it overhead until arms are extended.
Keep upper arms close to your head and elbows pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows until you feel a stretch.
Press back up to full extension by straightening your arms.
